Current letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

When I came across the Frontend Engineer opening at Bright Labs, I knew I wanted to apply. The focus of the position fits my experience well. I currently work as Frontend Engineer at Nimbus for over 5 years.

I noticed you value React, TypeScript and GraphQL; these have been core to my recent work. Built and maintained a component library used by 12 product teams; improved Lighthouse performance scores by 35% and led accessibility remediation to WCAG 2.1 AA. My background includes B.S. Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

I'd love to talk about how my background fits your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Aaliyah Huang

Return only the rewritten letter.

Dear Hiring Manager,

I was genuinely excited to see the Frontend Engineer opening at Bright Labs. Building accessible, high-performance React interfaces is exactly the work I care most about, and the idea of doing it on analytics tools that thousands of teams rely on is a strong pull for me.

Much of what you describe mirrors my day-to-day. At Nimbus I built and maintained the component library that twelve product teams depended on, so owning and evolving a design system end to end is familiar territory. I work in TypeScript by default and partner closely with product and design to take features from idea to ship.

Your emphasis on accessibility and performance is where I do some of my best work. I led our WCAG 2.1 AA remediation so the whole product met the standard, and I raised our Lighthouse performance scores by 35% through focused profiling and code-splitting. I'm also comfortable wiring up GraphQL APIs, which lines up with your stack.

I'd welcome the chance to bring that same focus on quality and inclusive design to Bright Labs. Thank you for considering my application, and I'd love to talk more about how I can help your team.

Sincerely,
Aaliyah Huang

Dear Hiring Manager,

The Registered Nurse, Medical-Surgical opening at Riverside Health immediately caught my eye. It's the kind of role I've been working toward. I currently work as Registered Nurse at Lakeside Medical Center for about 6 years, and I'm ready to bring that experience to your team.

I noticed you value IV therapy, patient care and EPIC EHR; these have been core to my recent work. To give a concrete example, provides care for up to 6 medical-surgical patients per shift; precepts new-grad nurses and championed a hand-off checklist that reduced medication errors. I also bring B.S. Nursing from University of Illinois.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Riverside Health. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Priya Nair

Dear Hiring Manager,

Compassionate, safe patient care is the heart of nursing for me, so I was glad to see the Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse opening at Riverside Health. Your emphasis on teamwork and patient safety is exactly the kind of unit I want to be part of.

I currently work as a Registered Nurse at Lakeside Medical Center, where I've spent the last several years caring for medical-surgical patients. On a typical shift I manage care for up to six patients, handle IV therapy and medications, and make patient education a priority so families understand what comes next.

The patient-safety focus in your posting is something I've acted on directly. I introduced a hand-off checklist on my unit that measurably reduced medication errors, and I regularly precept new-grad nurses, which has sharpened how clearly I communicate under pressure. I document thoroughly in EPIC and coordinate closely with the care team throughout the day.

I'd be grateful for the opportunity to bring that experience and care to your patients and staff. Thank you for considering my application, and I welcome the chance to discuss the role further.

Sincerely,
Priya Nair

The role asks for SQL, Python and Tableau, and those are exactly the strengths I'd bring. Built self-serve Tableau dashboards used across the company and ran A/B tests that informed a checkout redesign, lifting conversion 8%. My background includes B.S. Statistics from Ohio State.

Dear Hiring Manager,

Turning messy data into a decision someone can act on is my favorite part of analytics, so the Data Analyst role at Vantage caught my eye. I especially like the emphasis on presenting to non-technical stakeholders, because that's often where analysis actually turns into impact.

I currently work as a Data Analyst at Cartwheel, where I write SQL every day and build the dashboards teams rely on. My Tableau dashboards are self-serve, so people across the company can answer their own questions without waiting on me.

Experimentation is a strong part of my background, which fits what you're after. I ran the A/B tests behind a checkout redesign that raised conversion by 8%, and getting that adopted meant presenting the results clearly to people who don't live in spreadsheets. I also use Python for the heavier data-cleaning work.

I'd be excited to bring that mix of rigor and clear communication to Vantage. Thank you for your consideration, and I'd welcome the chance to talk through how I can help your teams make better decisions.
